description:
FOSS SRM AP brings to you: MLH HACKTOBER FEST!!
Get ready for the best hackathon of the year, organized by Next Tech Lab and FOSS. 12 hours of pure open-source building, late-night debugging, and shipping code. Work alongside top builders on campus, tackle real repositories, and claim official MLH and Hacktoberfest swag while fueled by constant caffeine and solid food. Bring your laptop and get ready to push commits all event long. Register now!!
